objective: Partition every current 28-truth obligation by the minimum form of information or proof that can settle it, instead of scheduling all open truths as generic benchmark/comparator work.

FIXED_THRESHOLD_DECISION.settlement: AN AUTHENTICATED PLATFORM_OR_BENCHMARK-OWNER PASS_FAIL VERDICT ON THE EXACT FROZEN PREDICATE IS SEMANTICALLY SUFFICIENT; AN EXACT SCORE OR PRIVATE DATASET IS NOT REQUIRED ONCE THE PREDICATE IS SETTLED.
FIXED_THRESHOLD_DECISION.important_boundary: RELATIVE ELO MAY NOT BE INFERRED FROM ABSOLUTE BEHAVIOR. THE BOOLEAN VERDICT MUST COME FROM THE EXACT RELATIVE-RATING PREDICATE OR A SOUND STRONGER BRIDGE.

DIRECT_HIDDEN_ORACLE.settlement: THE TWO PREDECLARED HIDDEN FINANCE ORACLE LEAVES MUST BE EXECUTED AND INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED. THIS DOES NOT REQUIRE OPUS EXECUTION, BUT IT IS NOT ROUTE-C E-EXACT OPTIMIZATION BECAUSE THE ORACLE IS HIDDEN FROM THE ACTING BRAIN.

BRAIN_FIRST_BINARY_MATCHED.settlement: FREEZE A COMPLETE FINITE CONTENT-ADDRESSED BINARY CASE UNIVERSE, RUN BRAIN ONCE, AND REQUIRE OPUS ONLY ON THE BRAIN-FAILURE RESIDUAL. ZERO OPUS CASE OUTPUTS ARE REQUIRED IF BRAIN PASSES THE COMPLETE CASE UNIVERSE.

RELATIVE_SCOPE_OR_QUALITY.settlement: NO CURRENT INFORMATION-COLLAPSING THEOREM IS PROVED. REQUIRE EITHER A STRONGER SCOPE-COMPLETE ABSOLUTE/FORMAL CERTIFICATE OR GENUINE TARGET-RELATIVE EVIDENCE.

META_TRANSFER.settlement: THESE ARE COVERAGE/QUOTIENT/TRANSFER THEOREM OBLIGATIONS. BENCHMARK EXECUTION IS NOT IMPLIED BY THEIR CLASSIFICATION; A SOUND EXTENSIONAL COVERAGE AND DOMINANCE-PRESERVING TRANSFER THEOREM IS THE PRIMARY ROUTE.

first_principles_consequence: THE PROJECT DOES NOT CURRENTLY HAVE 28 HOMOGENEOUS EVIDENCE PROBLEMS.
FOURTEEN TRUTHS CAN IN PRINCIPLE BE SETTLED WITHOUT ANY OPUS EXECUTION BY DIRECT PREDICATE OR ORACLE VERDICTS, UNLESS A STRONGER INTERNAL PROOF CLOSES THEM FIRST.
THREE BINARY MATCHED TRUTHS REQUIRE OPUS OUTPUT ONLY ON BRAIN FAILURES, WITH A ZERO-OPUS BEST CASE.
THE THREE RELATIVE SCOPE/QUALITY TRUTHS AND EIGHT META TRANSFER TRUTHS ARE THE HIGHEST-LEVERAGE INTERNAL-THEOREM TARGETS BEFORE SPENDING SCARCE TARGET-RELATIVE EVIDENCE.
JIT KNOWLEDGE MAY SUPPLY FACTS OR EXOGENOUS DISCRIMINATORS BUT MAY NOT SUPPLY AN OPAQUE TARGET POLICY, ACTION SELECTOR, OR HIDDEN GRADER LEAK.

scheduler.priority_1: ATTACK_META_TRANSFER_AND_EXTENSIONAL_TARGET_COVERAGE BECAUSE A SHARED THEOREM CAN DELETE OR RECLASSIFY MULTIPLE OPEN TRUTHS.
scheduler.priority_3: FINALIZE_THE_THREE_BRAIN_FIRST_BINARY_MATCHED PREEXPOSURE MANIFESTS; COMPARATOR REMAINS DOWNSTREAM OF BRAIN FAILURES ONLY.
scheduler.priority_4: DEFER_13_FIXED_THRESHOLD_AND_FINANCE_DIRECT_ORACLE REALITY CONSUMPTION UNTIL INTERNAL IMPLICATION ROUTES ARE EXHAUSTED.
scheduler.rule: AFTER_EVERY_VERIFIED_DELTA_RECOMPUTE_THIS_PARTITION; DO_NOT PRESERVE A ROUTE CLASS AFTER ITS PREMISES ARE DELETED.
